description: Gujarat has taken a major step toward becoming a leading AI hub with plans to establish a Sovereign AI Park in partnership with Sarvam AI
body_lead: Gandhinagar: Gujarat is poised to reinforce its standing as a growing technology hub, as Sarvam AI plans to set up a Sovereign AI Park in the state. The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the project was signed on March 18 during the AI Startup Dialogue held at the Chief Minister’s residence. During the event, the Chief Minister engaged with 24 high-potential startups from across the country, reviewing innovations spanning sectors such as agriculture, healthcare, education, and industry.
